name: Kaze
title: The Phantom Blade
description: A shadow-step master who strikes before the enemy can react. Wins through attrition and precision.

name: Ryuu
title: The Eternal Flame
description: A warrior of legendary power who channels primal fire through every blow. Ends fights fast.

name: Tsubaki
title: The Iron Lotus
description: An iron-willed warrior who outlasts everything thrown at her. Wins by still standing when everyone else falls.

name: Sora
title: The Stormcaller
description: A conduit for elemental chaos who bends lightning, ice, and storm to her will. Unmatched special power.

name: Ren
title: The Thunder Fist
description: A martial artist who channels raw electricity through every punch. Built like a tank but moves like lightning — unpredictable and relentless in close range.

name: Hana
title: The Void Walker
description: She steps through the void between moments, striking from positions that should be impossible. The fastest fighter alive — if you see her move, it's already too late.

name: Mira
title: The Cursed Sage
description: A forbidden arts practitioner whose curses rot through any defense over time. Fragile up front, catastrophic given enough turns — never let her reach the late game.

name: Gale
title: The Wild Tempest
description: Fights like a force of nature — chaotic, relentless, and terrifyingly strong. Gale gets stronger the longer a fight goes, rewarding those willing to take hits to deal them.

name: Naruto Uzumaki
title: Nine-Tails Jinchuriki
description: The unpredictable hyper-active ninja of the Leaf Village. Harnesses limitless reserves of Kurama tail-beast chakra to overwhelm foes with shadow clones and devastating Rasengans.

name: Sasuke Uchiha
title: The Avenger
description: The sole surviving prodigy of the legendary Uchiha clan. Wields the analytical power of the Mangekyo Sharingan and high-voltage Chidori strikes to dissect battlefields.

name: Kakashi Hatake
title: The Copy Ninja
description: A famous tactical veteran who has copied over a thousand jutsus. Uses precise spacing, defensive earth ramparts, and dimensional Kamui warps to outwit stronger opponents.

name: Madara Uchiha
title: Ghost of the Uchiha
description: An epoch-shattering deity of shinobi warfare. Commands colossal fire storms, invisible Limbo clones, and literal orbital asteroids that annihilate entire squads at once.

name: Monkey D. Luffy
title: Straw Hat Emperor
description: The captain of the Straw Hats and future King of the Pirates. Combines elastic rubber anatomy with Supreme King Haki to shatter physical limitations and turn imaginaton into reality.

name: Roronoa Zoro
title: King of Hell
description: The world-renowned swordsman who wields three cursed blades simultaneously. Unleashes cutting torrents that shear through iron, dragons, and spatial barriers with demon-god willpower.

name: Vinsmoke Sanji
title: Black Leg
description: The chivalrous combat chef whose kicking agility surpasses natural human reflexes. Ignites his legs into infernal blue flames to serve up explosive aerial combos.

name: Kaido of the Beasts
title: Strongest Creature Alive
description: The undying Emperor of the Sea and leader of the Beast Pirates. Transforms into a mythic Azure Dragon capable of absorbing lethal punishment before firing city-razing thermal lasers.

name: Ichigo Kurosaki
title: Substitute Soul Reaper
description: A combat hybrid uniting Soul Reaper, Hollow, Quincy, and Fullbring heritages. Enters Bankai to achieve impossible hypersonic speed and unleash sweeping black crescent Getsuga slashes.

name: Sosuke Aizen
title: Ruler of Illusions
description: The immortal former captain who stood atop the heavens. Wields complete hypnosis over all five human senses with Kyoka Suigetsu alongside unfathomably destructive Kido spells.

name: Byakuya Kuchiki
title: Captain of the 6th Division
description: The aristocratic noble master of Soul Society martial graces. Dissolves his blade into billions of glowing sakura cherry blossoms that shred enemies from every direction simultaneously.

name: Kenpachi Zaraki
title: The Bloodthirsty Captain
description: A monstrous battle maniac who wears an energy-devouring eyepatch just to give opponents a chance. Revels in sheer cutting force, tearing through dimensional fabric when serious.
